grade: Crianças bem pequenas (1 ano e 7 meses a 3 anos e 11 meses)
subject: O eu, o outro e o nós
description_pt: Comunicar-se com os colegas e os adultos, buscando compreendê-los e fazendo-se compreender.

components.description_pt: Expressar ideias pessoais claramente em discussões individuais, em grupo e lideradas pelo professor
components.description_en: Express personal ideas clearly in one-on-one, group, and teacher-led discussions
components.cc_component_description: Express personal ideas clearly in one-on-one, group, and teacher-led discussions

components.description_pt: Usar estratégias de escuta para compreender mensagens de colegas e adultos
components.description_en: Use listening strategies to understand messages from peers and adults
components.cc_component_description: Participate in conversations about grade 1 topics with diverse partners and adults

components.description_pt: Ajustar tentativas de comunicação para se fazer entender no contexto
components.description_en: Adjust communication attempts to make oneself understood in context
components.cc_component_description: Answer questions to clarify something not understood in a discussion

cc_matches.description: Engage effectively in a range of collaborative discussions (one-on-one, in groups, and teacher-led) with diverse partners on grade 6 topics, texts, and issues, building on others' ideas and expressing their own clearly.
Participate in collaborative conversations with diverse partners about grade 1 topics and texts with peers and adults in small and larger groups
Ask and answer questions in order to seek help, get information, or clarify something that is not understood.
